metadata_details.description: Mu Cartographer is a puzzle game released by Dutch independent developer Titouan Millet for Windows and MacOS in 2016. Described by Millet as an "experimental exploration game that can be enjoyed as an interactive visual toy", the game requires players to navigate a landscape by learning how to use the interface of a machine. Mu Cartographer was met with a generally favorable reception by reviewers,  with praise directed toward the game's visual presentation and cryptic design, with some criticism focused on the intuitiveness of the game's mechanics. Following release, the game was nominated for several awards at the 2017 Independent Games Festival.

metadata_details.description:
A chilling psychological horror set in 1980s Kerala. After weeks of silence, you arrive on a remote island to search for your missing wife. Explore an abandoned house, uncover local folklore, survive haunting encounters, and unravel the island’s buried secrets.

Thekku Island is a story-driven, first-person horror game set on a fictional island in 1980s Kerala, India.

You arrive on a remote island after weeks of silence from your wife — she vanished without a trace. As you search the abandoned house and the dark forests around it, you're pulled deeper into a chilling mystery that refuses to stay buried.

As night falls, eerie whispers and unsettling noises echo through the halls. Shadows seem to move on their own, creeping across the walls as if alive. The deeper you go, the more you realize — something is terribly wrong.

Inspired by Indian ghost stories, Thekku Island blends psychological horror, classic ghost encounters, and jumpscare tension into an atmospheric experience where every clue deepens the mystery. There are no easy answers — only whispers from the past.

metadata_details.description:
Go on a cross-country tour with your band in pursuit of fame, success, and happiness in this drama visual novel set during the summer of 2007.

Return to the Summer of 2007... 

Once somewhat of a local legend in their hometown, Mallory turned down a record deal in favour of a scholarship a decade ago. To say that they felt a bit of regret would be an understatement; they spent the bulk of their university years watching their former band mates sell out shows and records, stewing in bitterness the whole time.

After several years of rejection and struggling, they've finally gotten a second chance in their grasp — only to question whether it's something they even want anymore.

After years of hard work, Mal has finally gotten everything they've always dreamed of: their band, No Prospects, landed a coveted spot on the 2007 Friends and Foes summer tour, and their latest single has been picked up by some big radio stations. So they should be happy, right?

The bassist of The Fractured — the current band that's on the playlist of everyone who's in-the-know. Most would consider Emerson's quiet and withdrawn nature ill-suited for the spotlight, so it's fortunate that he seems to get overshadowed by the rest of his group.

Mallory’s best friend from university who was dragged into No Prospects largely against her will. Despite her initial reluctance, ever-critical Di has since given her all in every single performance – and won’t hesitate to point out anyone she believes to be dead weight.

An old friend of Mallory's from their teenage basement show years. Having spent the past decade turning down permanent positions in favour of juggling odd jobs with occasional freelance session work, Beckett surprised everyone when he joined No Prospects.

metadata_details.description:
How much can you collect before the ship goes under? How will you use what you have? Act fast and make constant choices to escape the sea or become its next victim.

'Don't Sleep With The Fishes' is a point-and-click survival horror game focused on rapid salvaging, resource management, and surviving day by day at sea featuring:

Randomized scavenging and events.

3 Different shipmates to take with you and talk to.

A cozy and creepy atmosphere that alternates between day and night. (This game contains Jumpscares!)
